danil.connect_machine.title: Connect another machine
danil.connect_machine.description: A VPS, your own EC2, another laptop or a Raspberry Pi: run tasks there and control them from here.
danil.connect_machine.intro: Connect a VPS (DigitalOcean, Hetzner…), your own EC2, another laptop or a Raspberry Pi. Connecting is free with no machine limit; controlling them from the web or the phone is part of Danil.
danil.connect_machine.name: Name in your account (optional)
danil.connect_machine.platforms: Paste it in that machine's terminal as your user, without sudo. Linux x86_64 or arm64 with glibc 2.35 or newer, or macOS.
danil.connect_machine.step_install: Install Seldon Host with the command
danil.connect_machine.step_approve: Open the link it shows and approve the code with this account
danil.connect_machine.step_online: The machine shows up here online

danil.connect_machine.failed.machine_tim: No new machine showed up in your account.
danil.connect_machine.failed.machine_off: {name} joined your account but does not open its connection.
danil.connect_machine.failed.version_mis: {name} is online with another engine version.
danil.connect_machine.fix.unauthorized: Sign in with your Danil account again and open this again.
danil.connect_machine.fix.machine_timeou: On the other machine, check that the command showed a code and approve it with this same account within 10 minutes. If it says which step failed, follow its fix; to retry: danil computers connect. If the command does not exist, run the install command again: it updates it and it stays the same computer.
danil.connect_machine.fix.machine_off: On that machine run danil computers status: if the relay does not open, check outbound HTTPS to computers.danil.ai (proxy or firewall) and the service (systemctl --user status seldon-host or launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/ai.danil.seldon.host). If the command does not exist, run the install command again: it updates it and it stays the same computer.
danil.connect_machine.fix.version_mismat: Run the install command again on that machine: it updates it and it stays the same computer.
danil.connect_machine.own_power: Your own machines are not turned on from Danil: when one is off, it shows as off until it comes back.
